features: Sleek, Comfortable Design: Featuring ultra-thin, modern design with scissor switches for slimmer keys and compact, low-profile mouse. Elevate your home or office desk setup into a visual statement
Less space, more performance: The compact Windows-optimised keyboard layout fits a number pad, 12 FN shortcuts and all the keys you need for great productivity right at hand, even on a small desk
Ultra portable mouse: The ambidextrous flat pebble shape of the 3 button cordless mouse houses a wide rubber mechanical scroll wheel and incorporates High Precision Optical Tracking (1000 DPI)
Whisper-quiet work: A quiet keyboard with fluid and familiar laptop-like typing and a lab-tested, 90% noise-reduced mouse – meaning an ultra quiet work experience for you and those around you
Easy, reliable wireless: Easily connect the combo with a 2.4GHz wireless USB Logitech mini-Receiver for easy, reliable wireless. Get a strong, stable connection with 10 meters (33ft) of range(2)
Long-lasting Combo: Get 18 months of mouse use and 36 months of keyboard use through the battery-saving auto-sleep feature, which means you don’t have to worry about losing power(3)
Own Your Space: Simple plug-and-play connectivity for laptop and desktop computer, allowing for productivity while you travel, clean cable-free desk space. Compatible with Windows, Works with Surface
